title: doc-changes
description: explain-pr: the changed Markdown documents (.md, .markdown), fragment by fragment, rendered as formatted Markdown with added parts marked `+` and removed parts `−`, and a switch to the raw diff. The agent writes `path`, an optional `summary` and the `fragments` it describes; the engine reads the diff between `base` and `repo` from git (three lines of context, as `git diff` prints it), embeds both versions of each file and puts them on the page. A fragment is one hunk of that diff, picked by `find`. A hunk no fragment describes is still shown, titled by its section heading. Validation fails when a path is not Markdown, is not changed, is listed twice, or when `find` is in no hunk, in several hunks, or in a hunk another fragment already took.

repo.description: The head side: a key of `repos`, e.g. "shop".

base.description: The base side: a key of `repos`, e.g. "shop@base". Its sha must exist in the head checkout.

files.description: The changed Markdown files this block shows, one tab each. These paths count as shown on the page.

id.description: Part id, unique in the block; a route step can focus it.

path.description: File path from the repo root, as `verstat facts diff` prints it.

summary.description: What changed in the document, in one sentence.

id.description: Part id; a route step can focus the fragment.

find.description: Text from one line of the hunk: an added, removed or context line. It must occur in exactly one hunk of the file.

kind.description: read — the meaning changed (open by default); skim — small or mechanical; skip — wording, links, formatting.

title.description: What the fragment changes, in a few words.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what the change says.

commit.description: The commit that made the change; a click on that commit in `commits` keeps it, others dim it.
